messages:
anya: Quick check — updating primary CTA group in dashboard row card to a more compact visual density. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/console-ui. Noticed the icon + chevron are slightly lower than the label at 24px height. Also the focus ring gets clipped when buttons sit flush inside the card. Thoughts?

mike: seeing it. can you paste a screenshot? :eyes:

anya: pasted screenshot: https://imgur.com/example-snap. Also the quick CSS I'm testing: 
```css
.button--compact { padding: 6px 8px; height: 24px; line-height: 24px; }
.button--icon { transform: translateY(-1px); }
```

jordan: compact padding looks nice visually but 24px interactive height will fail touch-target a11y (44px recommended). We should keep visuals compact but preserve a larger hit area (invisible padding) or switch to a two-tier control (icon-only vs full).

lee: agree. prefer keeping visual compactness while expanding tappable area. suggestion: add extra hit padding via an adjacent wrapper instead of changing card layout. e.g. 
```css
.button-hit-area { padding: 10px; margin: -10px; }
```
that keeps visuals but increases touch size.

harper: also the focus ring is clipped because .card has overflow: hidden. either make action wrapper overflow: visible or use outline-offset on the button. e.g. 
```css
.button { outline-offset: 2px; }
.card-actions { overflow: visible; }
```
Careful: changing card overflow can affect shadows.

anya: good point. wrapping the actions in an overflow-visible layer is probably safest. i'll prototype.

mike: on the icon vertical shift — avoid hard translateY. prefer baseline fixes: set svg viewBox and use flex centering. try: 
```css
.button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.button svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; vertical-align: middle; }
```
this should remove pixel nudges.

jordan: yep, center with flex and explicit svg dims. that also helps when we change font-size/line-height.

anya: small copy tweak: change label from "Run eval" to "Run evaluation" in the row action — clearer for new users. objections?

lee: prefer the clearer phrasing. export strings please (i18n check).

harper: tooltip/toast timing: current success toasts disappear ~1.2s which feels too short on slow connections. propose: success 1.8s, info 2.4s, error 3s. we should surface durations as tokens.

design-bot: new token created: spacing.compact = 6px, spacing.touch-pad = 10px, toast.duration.success = 180ms? (typo?) PR: #452. :robot_face:

mike: small QA note: ensure buttons handle long translations and RTL. add min-width: 0 and text-overflow: ellipsis on labels inside flexible containers.

anya: will update Figma and push a PR with changes: increase hit area via wrapper, remove translateY hacks, center icons with flex, adjust outline/overflow handling, and update toast durations and copy. aiming to get this out by EOD.

jordan: :thumbsup:

harper: happy to draft the accessibility test cases — will add keyboard focus, touch hit-targets, and screen reader label checks. ping me when PR is up.

mike: also let's add a short visual regression CI check for the card action row (variant with long text + icon-only) so we don't regress spacing.

anya: noted. thanks all.
